target_claim: Historical feedback reliance predicts immediate phase-error inflation when usable downstream correction opportunity is lost.

required_design.preferred: within taxon / within population / matched route comparison
required_variables: entry phase error or entry-phase variance before the opportunity perturbation
historically available correction opportunity count or predeclared weighted opportunity amount
downstream phase error or final phase variance on the same coordinate
independent perturbation definition that does not use the downstream phase outcome
preferred_perturbations: experimental removal or blocking of an otherwise available correction action

primary_prediction.qualitative: for comparable opportunity loss, systems or individuals with higher pre-perturbation feedback reliance should show greater phase-error inflation
primary_prediction.strongest_test: interaction between independently estimated historical feedback reliance and opportunity loss on downstream error inflation

forbidden_designs: cross-taxon correlation between migration distance and mismatch used as the primary test
using number of stopovers as both the perturbation and the outcome
estimating historical feedback reliance from the same post-perturbation phase error used to test fragility
treating a published route-scale surfing decline alone as an estimate of omega
treating the Aikens industrial mule-deer system as a confirmation without a direct phase-retention/opportunity decomposition
retuning frozen GEB V2 or preregistered outcomes

current_anchor.system: Aikens et al. 2022 industrial mule deer
current_anchor.licensed: landscape development altered migration behavior and reduced route-scale green-wave surfing; PAYOFF-B reanalysis found lower near-boundary movement-control permeability in large-development population
current_anchor.not_licensed: direct clock-portfolio fragility test; omega, s_feedback and target-relative variance inflation are not identified

decision_rule: No natural system is promoted as a portfolio-fragility confirmation until historical feedback reliance and opportunity loss are independently identified before the downstream mismatch outcome is evaluated.
